Scg Sir is very passionate about physics. You have to understand what he teaches you. After every chapter he finishes he will assign you an assignment for 3/4 days. He will also announce the quiz from the same assignment syllabus. Quiz will be 10 marks ; 4 marks will be theory and 6 marks will be a mathematical problem. His questions will be on a thing happen how, why and when for the theory portion. Mathematical problems will be from the assignments. His assignments are indirectly your questions for mid and final exams. Mid final questions will be slightly twisted from his assignments. If you can solve the assignments by yourself you can ensure a good grade. He teaches very well and doesn’t curve grade, so think twice before doing this course under him.He is a good teacher but he expects a lot and everything is theoreticalIf you can't understand the theory, you can't even answer the mathsRaw marks will be your final grade.
